requirement.description: The Flask hook is not properly detecting and hooking Flask app instances that are created in test modules. The hook_flask function passes an empty list to hook_generic, but doesn't pass the actual Flask app instances that are created in the test modules, causing view functions and error handlers to not be intercepted.
requirement.contract: The hook_flask function should properly detect Flask app instances from the test modules and pass them to hook_generic so that view functions and error handlers can be properly hooked.

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism needs to be enhanced to better detect Flask apps that are created in test modules, particularly when they are passed as initiators. Currently, the detection logic is insufficient to identify Flask apps that are created locally within test functions.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function should properly detect Flask app instances even when they are created locally within test modules, by checking for Flask app attributes like 'route', 'view_functions', and 'error_handlers'.

requirement.description: The httprecord context manager needs to pass the Flask app instances correctly to the hook_flask function so they can be properly detected and hooked.
requirement.contract: The httprecord function should pass the initiators list to hook_flask, allowing Flask apps created in test modules to be properly detected and hooked.
